items.source: Default is true when the "warn" level is enabled. Subclasses can override this to change the level under which logging occurs.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当启用"warn"级别时，该值为true。子类可以重写此方法以更改日志记录发生的级别。

items.source:
This can be specified to not log into the category of this warner class but rather
into a specific named category.
items.translation: 这可以指定不登录到该告警器类别，而是登录到特定的命名类别。

items.source: The default implementations logs the message at "warn" level.
items.translation: 默认实现以“warn”级别记录该消息。

items.source: Determine whether the logger field is enabled.
items.translation: 确定是否启用了logger字段。

items.source: Logs a warning for a bean annotated with @Deprecated.
items.translation: 为带有@Deprecated注解的 Bean 记录警告。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: beanName - the name of the deprecated bean

items.source: beanType - the user-specified type of the deprecated bean
items.translation: beanType - 用户指定的已弃用 Bean 的类型

items.source: beanDefinition - the definition of the deprecated bean
items.translation: beanDefinition - 已弃用 Bean 的定义

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：BeanFactoryPostProcessor

items.source: Bean factory post processor that logs a warning for @Deprecated beans.
items.translation: 记录针对带有 `@Deprecated` 注解的 Bean 发出警告的 Bean 工厂后处理器。

items.source:
Modify the application context's internal bean factory after its standard
initialization.
items.translation: 在标准初始化之后修改应用程序上下文的内部 BeanFactory。

items.source: Set the name of the logger to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的日志记录器名称。

items.source: Actually write to the underlying log.
items.translation: 实际上写入底层日志。

items.source:
Modify the application context's internal bean factory after its standard
initialization. All bean definitions will have been loaded, but no beans
will have been instantiated yet. This allows for overriding or adding
properties even to eager-initializing beans.
items.translation: 在标准初始化之后修改应用程序上下文内部的 Bean 工厂。此时所有 Bean 定义都已被加载，但尚未实例化任何 Bean。这允许您甚至对急切初始化的 Bean 进行属性覆盖或添加。
